Commonwealth Migration – Guest Post Prospecting Summary
A prospect universe for Commonwealth Migration (https://commonwealthmigration.ca/) focused on Brampton first, then Canada, then the United Kingdom.
Start with P1 rows, then review P2 rows. Personalize the pitch around a genuine audience benefit and a specific article idea.
Feedspot rows are sourced from topical authority lists; this workbook does not claim that every site accepts guest posts or has a dofollow policy.
Before outreach, manually verify current DR/DA, organic traffic, topical relevance, indexation, outbound-link quality, contributor policy, and the correct editor/contact route.
Avoid mass identical outreach, paid-link schemes, irrelevant placements, spun content, or claims that a link will be dofollow unless the publisher confirms it.
Rows labeled explicit editorial/partnership route have a cited contributor, submit-story, outreach, or contact page and should be checked first.
Use a real human sender when possible. “Anooj Dhawan” is preferable for relationship-based outreach; “Blog Master” can be used for a role-based mailbox.
404 deduplicated prospects across immigration, visa, Canadian newcomer, local GTA, Canada, UK, law, expat, and adjacent publisher categories.
